whenToUse: Moving between screens with depth, such as a list and its details.
whenNotToUse: Small changes within the same screen (move only that element).
Screens people move between quickly and often (the transition becomes a wait).

alternatives.name: Shared Element Transition
alternatives.reason: The pressed element continues into the next screen.

alternatives.name: Zoom Transition
alternatives.reason: A screen grows out of an icon or card.

accessibility: When the screen changes, move focus to the new screen so keyboard and screen reader users don't lose their place.
Going back moves the opposite way, consistently showing which screen comes first.
With reduced motion, every transition becomes a short fade.
The content changes immediately even during the transition, so no one waits for the animation.
